use_case: Drift prediction feature in the calibration-tracking SaaS: predicts when each survey instrument will drift out of tolerance from calibration results and response-check readings (adapted from the registry default "predictive maintenance for non-safety plant equipment")
vendor_or_model: Calibration-tracking SaaS vendor (machine learning model trained by the vendor; feature turned on 2026-05-18)
data_categories: Instrument serial numbers; calibration results; response-check readings; client site, building, and room tags until they are removed (due 2026-09-30) (Client A information under CSR-A (6))
human_in_the_loop: The owner decides every instrument action. Predictions may only bring a check or calibration forward, never delay one; annual laboratory calibration and the pre-use response check continue regardless
applicable_laws: CSR-A (6) for Client A site data; client licensees must ensure instruments are calibrated periodically (10 CFR 20.1501(c) and the Florida equivalent for Florida licensees), so a prediction can never replace a calibration; no AI-specific statute applies
status: In production (approved 2026-08-31 on conditions; site tags removed by 2026-09-30)

data_categories: One paragraph of Client B security information (2026-06-09)
human_in_the_loop: Owner wrote and checked the final text
